description: This dataset from AERPAW, the National Science Foundation's aerial wireless research platform run from North Carolina State University, holds LTE and WiFi signal strength measurements taken indoors and outdoors across the university's campuses in Raleigh. The dataset page read on 2026-09-28 names Gautham Reddy of NC State as lead experimenter, classes it as a non-canonical experiment, points to the files on Google Drive and lists publications that used it. Coverage is the NC State University campuses. Access is free through the linked drive; no licence is stated on the page, and the file formats, sample counts and dates were not read. Caveats: this is a small campus measurement campaign, device and network details should be checked in the files or papers before reuse, and cloud drive links can disappear. It supports telecom coverage studies, such as training or checking indoor to outdoor propagation models used to estimate mobile service in buildings during an emergency. Related record: OpenLain5G offers a reproducible LTE and 5G laboratory framework for similar experiments.
